00013.why: Built by hand at Cam's request. OSM had only the boundary: holes traced from USDA NAIP with the club's routing map, routed and treed from 2022 lidar, back tees cut to card length. 6723 of 6822 yd; greens and bunkers traced from the photo, green contours from lidar.

cam-2026-10-27-rushcreek.why: Built at Cam's request (chat, not a feedback note). OSM main outline way/1040390809 (fetch first picked the Mac 9 outline), 18 hole ways by id; greens from 2022 MN lidar (QL1, 30-85 pts/m2), 3/9/10 softened to ~3.2%. 7189 of 7306 yd.

cam-2026-11-07-sandbox.why: Built at Cam's request (chat). OSM outline way/1552049150, 17 hole ways; greens from WI_Adams_2019 lidar (5 pts/m2, unsoftened; several greens 4-6% median, outlines checked against the photo). 1592 of 1531 yd (Shovels). cam-2026-11-07-gnshort.why: Grand National Short (Opelika AL), Cam's request. OSM has 17 of 18 hole ways with no ref or name (ids 1098809319-337, 1319991738-5278) and one unclaimed green at ~32.67694,-85.41729; routing can be chained from the map but the published cards disagree (GolfingRecord purple 3292 with hole 9 = 250; Hole19 orange 2481 with different per-hole yards) and neither fits the mapped holes (60-90 yd off per hole, map total ~2,860). Needs the club's card or a routing map. Fetch box [-85.4215,32.6722,-85.4109,32.6818] (job 'boxes'), lidar GA_Central_2_2018.

cam-2026-11-19-tiburon.why: Built at Cam's request (chat). Gold course of the OSM Tiburón outline relation/5462396 (36 holes; Gold holes picked by course=gold). Card from GolfingRecord (Gold 7271, pars match OSM); 18Birdies' 'Gold' card is really the Black. Back tees set on 8 and 18; 7052 of 7271 yd. Range traced from the photo.

00021.why: Requested by OgTwig. OSM outline way/549707454 is unnamed (fetched by id); 18 hole ways, 20 greens. Card: GolfPass Blue 6117 par 72 (OSM pars 5 and 14 differ, card used). Built 6046 yd; tee 10 set by hand to the forward end of its box (card 145). Lidar MN_SEDriftless_5_2021 (QL0), greens unsoftened, 7 and 10 ~5% median with outlines checked. Range placed by place.py (none found on the photo). Clubhouse measured from lidar (7 blocks), look from the club website patio photo. Nov 21 (Cam): back tees switched to Black: 18Birdies/GolfLink Black row (the par-70 layout, 6373) with holes 5 and 14 at the Blue yardage (par-72 Black, 6507; GolfPass says 6499). Built 6279 yd; sets Blue and White (Red dropped).

00024.why: Requested by Pappa ('geneva national: palmer, player and trevino nines'; Geneva National has three 18-hole courses, one per request: built the Palmer, the others can be requested). OSM outline relation/8400251 is unnamed and holds all 3 courses (53 hole ways); Palmer's 17 picked by id (pars match the card), hole 16 (missing in OSM) added from its mapped tees and green. Card: GolfPass Black 7083 par 72; built 6948 yd; sets Gold and White. 3DEP lon/lat export returned HTTP 500, so demll was resampled locally from the UTM 1 m grid. Lidar WI_SEWRPC_2017 (~3-6 pts/m2), greens unsoftened: 1 (6.0%), 6 and 7 (5.3%), 3 (4.8%), 2 (4.3%) median with outlines checked against the photo; all pins <= 2.43%. Range mapped in OSM. Clubhouse measured from lidar (12 blocks, median 0.06 yd); no clubhouse or course photos found, so default look and no landmarks.

00025.why: Requested by OgTwig ('Le Golf National — France'). First skipped (outside the lower 48), then built the same night at Cam's request with new France data sources (IGN: BD ORTHO photo, LiDAR HD terrain model and classified points, LiDAR HD for the clubhouse and measured trees). Built L'Albatros (the Ryder Cup / Olympic course; L'Aigle and L'Oiselet can be requested). OSM outline way/290619725 'Golf National' holds all three courses; Albatros's 18 holes picked by id. Card: GolfPass Black 7272 par 72 (club card: 18 is par 5; tour events play it as a par 4, par 71); built 7156 yd, 14 is 553 (card 595, the mapped back tee matches the Olympic 552). Sets White and Yellow. Lidar IGN LiDAR HD Feb 2022 (10-17 ground pts/m2), greens unsoftened, all medians <= 3.2%, pins <= 2.2%. RGE ALTI 1 m was tried first and predates the 2016-17 rebuild (bunkers ~7 cm deep), so the terrain is the LiDAR HD MNT (bunkers -64 cm). Range mapped in OSM. Clubhouse (the golfnational/ffgolf building next to the Novotel) measured from lidar, 2 blocks, median 0.07 yd; look from photos; timber bulkheads and grey timber bridges. Game map: FR badge in the Atlantic (home-screen.js).
